final.scope: Core synthesis/output; workspace, HDR, custom sampling, history, API equivalence/stale/busy/invalid/revocation; factory menu regression; Select and Mask; Spot Healing.

live: Not run; prior locked-screen state was not bypassed or repeatedly probed. Procedural output is not UI or Photoshop reference evidence.
limits: Ordinary raster layer and RGB composite context. Source/document masks are bounded to 16,777,216 pixels and synthesis including transformed source variants to 4,194,304 pixels. Requests above the bounds fail explicitly.
The deterministic native PatchMatch/membrane/adaptation implementation is not Adobe proprietary synthesis; exact pixels remain unqualified.
Cross-document sampling, polygonal selection, Apply/multiple-fill session semantics and finer preview/navigation/preferences parity remain open.
Saved alpha channels can provide custom sampling. PSD/PSB documents with alpha channels still encounter the explicit step167 export guard; existing raster-only output encoding is tested.
Content-Aware Scale, crop fill and richer Fill integration remain separate major work.
No dedicated published Photoshop v2 CAF endpoint; content-aware actionJSON descriptors remain explicitly unsupported.
Full regression, optimized runtime, physical Intel and macOS14/26/live qualification remain open and batched for later major milestones.
